pick.headline: Carter confirms US boycott of the Moscow Olympics
pick.summary: On 21 March 1980 President Carter told US athletes that the United States would not send a team to the Moscow Olympics.
pick.significance: The boycott, protesting the invasion of Afghanistan, was joined by dozens of countries.

alternates.headline: Namibia becomes independent
alternates.summary: On 21 March 1990 Namibia became independent from South African rule.
alternates.significance: Independence completed the 1988 accords that also removed Cuban troops from Angola.
